pages.text: $(italic)Brutal and relentless. Orcs hit harder, swing faster, and take more punishment — but burn through food at an alarming rate.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Orcish Strength$() — $(item)+10% melee damage$(). Raw brute force.$(br2)$(bold)Battle Fury$() — $(item)+10% attack speed$(). Orcs swing fast and hard.$(br2)$(bold)Orcish Endurance$() — $(item)+20% max health$(). Built tough.$(br2)$(bold)Bloodlust$() — $(item)Up to +20% bonus damage as hunger increases$(). The hungrier you are, the harder you hit.$(br2)$(bold)Ravenous$() — $(warn)+50% hunger drain$(). The fury burns through food.
